reference.criterion: Interest and practical work on neural/evolutionary methods increase while conventional computation remains important.
reference.rationale: The 2006 deep-belief-net paper is a concrete pre-deadline advance consistent with renewed neural-method development. The 2012 ImageNet result and subsequent AI systems decisively reinforce the broad direction; no majority-of-all-computation threshold is imposed on this weaker claim.
